props.title: The workflow produces its output. Two safeguards need checking before unattended use.
props.description: One isolated run completed. Overlapping writes and timeout recovery still need attention. This example shows how to report a verdict, its evidence and the work it implies.

props.title: Findings, most urgent first
props.description: When: now = before the next run; next = before release.

props.title: Resolve the overlapping writes first
props.text: In this synthetic scenario, two writers share one output. A successful isolated run does not establish that concurrent runs are safe.

props.title: Run once in isolation
props.description: Pause the second job through its existing control, then inspect the first job’s output. Add an exact command here only after verifying its target and effect.

props.title: What is verified as working
props.description: State: ok = exercised by the cited synthetic check; no = configured but not exercised.

items: Operator: keep the next run isolated.
Maintainer: add an overlap guard and rehearse timeout recovery.
Reviewer: recheck both findings before enabling unattended runs.

props.text: All claims, counts and traces on this page are synthetic. No production system was inspected. In a real review, record the sources and observation time here, distinguish configuration from verified behavior, and name the checks that remain untested.
